name: Microwave Mug Scrambled Eggs
instructions:
1. Crack eggs into a microwave-safe mug and whisk with a fork.
2. Add a splash of milk, salt, and pepper.
3. Microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring between each, until just set (about 90 seconds total).
4. Top with cheese if desired and serve.

name: Instant Ramen Upgrade
instructions:
1. Boil water in the kettle.
2. Place ramen noodles and seasoning packet in a microwave-safe bowl.
3. Pour boiling water over noodles, cover, and let sit 3 minutes.
4. Stir in a soft-boiled egg and green onion.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Breast
instructions:
1. Pat chicken breast dry and rub with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
2. Preheat air fryer to 380°F (193°C).
3. Cook chicken 9-10 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
4. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Stovetop Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions:
1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
2. Melt butter in a pan over medium heat, add minced garlic, cook 1 minute.
3. Toss drained pasta into the pan with butter, garlic, and a splash of pasta water.
4. Season with salt, pepper, and grated parmesan.

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Veggies & Sausage
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
2. Toss sliced sausage, bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
3. Roast 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway, until vegetables are caramelized.

name: Blender Berry Smoothie
instructions:
1. Add frozen berries, banana, yogurt, and milk to the blender.
2. Blend until smooth, adding more milk to reach desired consistency.
3. Pour and serve immediately.
